depends_on_prs.role: NablaMimic policy adapter with the confirmed reference-frame indexing fix

physics.robot: canonical G1 29-DoF, mjlab FULL_COLLISION (unchanged from V1)
physics.action: q_setpoint = default_joint_pos + action_scale * a (absolute action contract)
physics.events: none (no encoder bias / COM offset / foot friction randomization; no reset noise)
physics.note: V2 reuses V1's compiled robot model, actuators, contact set and CSV->npz converter verbatim. Physics is NOT changed.

reference_motion.converter: mjlab scripts/csv_to_npz.MotionLoader + Scene/Simulation teleport FK (V1 motion.py, unchanged)

reward.error_frame: world frame; body pose errors use BeyondMimic xy+yaw reference re-anchoring
reward.excluded_terms_reason: Neither original evaluation has a self-collision reward penalty. Self-collision PHYSICS is kept (full_self_collision=true).
reward.root_anchor_note: V2 uses NablaMimic==mjlab torso_link anchor. SuperMimic uses pelvis for these four terms; that is a documented, unresolved divergence, not a numerical match.

termination.excluded_terms_reason: ee_body_pos does not exist in either original evaluation; mjlab anchor_pos/anchor_ori use torso_link while both original terminations use pelvis, so minimal glue replaces them.
termination.time_out: retained in mjlab config but never fires in play mode; the rollout driver ends at T-1 steps

normalization.per_clip: sum over alive steps of r_t / ((T - 1) * max_step_reward)
normalization.T: number of 50 Hz reference frames in the full clip
normalization.denominator: full clip theoretical maximum (unchanged by early termination)
normalization.aggregate: unweighted mean of the 40 per-clip normalized returns
normalization.failed_clips: number of clips terminated by root_height / root_tilt / nonfinite before clip end
normalization.note: Reproduces supermimic/evaluate.py:84 and nablamimic/evaluate.py:90 exactly. V1 additionally clamps each clip to [0,1] (runner.py:164); V2 does not.

quality_gate.reason: V1's 0.82 / 0-of-40 gate is tied to V1's rubric and cannot be carried over. V2 has no scored records yet; a gate must be calibrated on a real GPU 40-clip run before any leaderboard use.
